title: the lamb and the wolf
summary: The lamb walks up to the wolf and ask:
content:
The lamb walks up to the wolf and ask: “My dear, Wolf. Why do you like me so much?” 

The wolf just stared. Didn't get it. “I eat you, don't like you,” he answered unsure. 

“But you think I taste good, then you have to like me.” 

Now the wolf was completely lost. “I do like the taste of you.” 

“See, so you like me.” 

The wolf was thinking over that. And whiled it, the lamb walked away, unhurt. And happy like few.
